item.description: 🇷🇺 🇧🇳 On October 2, the Russian Foreign Ministry hosted the opening of an exhibition of archival documents and photographs marking the 35th anniversary of diplomatic relations between Russia and Brunei . In their welcoming remarks, Russia’s Deputy Foreign Minister Andrey Rudenko and Ambassador Extraordinary and Plenipotentiary of Brunei Darussalam to Russia Husaini Alauddin reaffirmed their countries’ commitment to further strengthening bilateral cooperation in a spirit of friendship, trust and mutual respect . The Sides expressed their determination to expand political dialogue and deepen ties in defence and security, trade and humanitarian exchanges. They also noted that Russia and Brunei share identical or similar positions on key international and regional issues . The event was also attended by Heads of diplomatic missions of other #ASEAN member states in Moscow, representatives of Russian ministries and agencies, civil society and academia, and journalists. #RussiaBrunei

A central role is played by the Polish company Wytwornia Broni Jacek Popinski , registered in Rogow, Lodz Province. It purchases pistols, including from the Panamanian branch of Austrian firearms manufacturer Glock, and resells them to Ukraine. ☝️ For every shipment of 5,000 pistols, €625,000 is transferred to accounts held by trusted associates of the SBU leadership . The Belgian and German defence ministries foot the entire bill. 🎙
Russian Foreign Ministry Spokeswoman Maria Zakharova’s
answer to a media question
regarding the withdrawal of foreign troops from Iraq
(October 2, 2026)
❓
Question: On September 30, the US-led Anti-ISIS Coalition announced the completion of its troop withdrawal from Iraq. How does Russia view this event?
💬
Maria Zakharova:
Indeed, on September 30,
the twelve-year presence in Iraq of the so-called International Anti-ISIS Coalition came to an end.
All remaining bases of the US Armed Forces and their allies in the country – mainly within Iraqi Kurdistan – have been fully transferred to the control of the Iraqi military.
The decision by the Iraqi Parliament, adopted in January 2020 and fully
reflecting the aspiration of its people to restore and consolidate state sovereignty
after the prolonged presence of foreign forces, has thus been implemented.
That presence had effectively continued since 2003 – from the moment of the American invasion under a completely contrived pretext, which triggered decades of instability across the wider region.
The withdrawal of troops from Iraq, which
we certainly welcome
, demonstrates that the Iraqi army and security forces are capable of independently addressing the task of strengthening the state’s defence capability and ensuring national security. They are capable, among other things, of countering the terrorist threat emanating from ISIS and other such organisations.
We are convinced that
the Iraqi people will be able to successfully withstand any internal and external challenges that confront them.
The guarantee of this lies in neighbourly relations and coordination with neighbouring countries; in this regard, we would like once again to draw attention to
the Collective Security Concept for the Gulf Region proposed by Russia.
☝️
It proceeds from the understanding that it is precisely the states located there, such as Iraq, that
play the leading role in maintaining stability in this strategically important region through close interaction among themselves.

🎙
Statement
by Ms. Iulia Zhdanova, Head of the Delegation of the Russian Federation to the Vienna Negotiations on Military Security and Arms Control, at the 1147th meeting of the OSCE Forum for Security Co-operation
Vienna, September 30, 2026
Agenda item: Special Military operation to demilitarize and denazify Ukraine
• The reckless actions of the Kiev regime's Western sponsors continue to pose a threat to peace and security. Right now, Europe is
doing everything it can to hinder a peaceful settlement and disrupt the prospects for negotiations
: they are pumping the Ukrainian regime with money and weapons, and helping to aim UAVs and missiles at civilians and civilian infrastructure.
• European countries are deliberately escalating the situation.
They continue to convince their citizens of a mythical "Russian threat" and the need to prepare for hostilities, for a war against Russia
. Their goal is
the routinization and normalization of a critical scenario in the public consciousness
. The course toward fueling the conflict is evident.
• It has long been clear that the territory of Ukraine is being used by
#NATO
member states as
a testing ground for trying out new weapons systems and disposing of old ones under real combat conditions
. However, it is also a convenient way for Western pseudo-peacemakers to fight Russia by proxy for the time being, while remaining "above the main fray." To this end, the process of "merging" the military-industrial complexes of Ukraine and European countries is underway at full speed.
• The current course of European governments is clearly aimed at
preparing their military-industrial complex, state apparatus, economy, and civilian infrastructure for aggressive actions against Russia
. Under these conditions, the recent statements made in New York by
#NATO
Secretary General M. Rutte—that
#NATO
countries are ready to provide Ukraine with certain security guarantees after the conflict—prove once again that
neither the Kiev regime nor its Western handlers are aimed at de-escalation and a settlement
.
• Within the framework of the special military operation, we note numerous instances of the Kiev regime violating the norms and principles of international humanitarian law (IHL). Armed Forces of Ukraine (AFU) units are mining territories of the Russian Federation to inflict damage on
civilian infrastructure and the peaceful population
. To this end, Kiev deliberately uses mines, booby traps, and improvised explosive devices, which are deployed to mine roadsides between settlements, bridges, dams, residential buildings, medical institutions, schools, and kindergartens.
• In the European Union, where they boast of "European values," they have remained completely silent: not a single word of condemnation.
They only say that Ukraine is helping to defend "European values."
In the West, humanitarian norms are being transformed from universal obligations into a tool for selective polemics, while the interests of the victims recede into the background, if not the third plan.
• The West also covers up
widespread human rights violations during mobilization in Ukraine
. This refers to the forced delivery of citizens to territorial recruitment centers (TRCs), unlawful imprisonment, physical violence, and the obstruction of access to legal assistance.
• Having started the special military operation in 2022 to protect the people of Donbas and Novorossiya from extermination by the Kiev regime, Russia continues to fight for their security and rights in full accordance with the letter and spirit of the UN Charter.
Our struggle for truth and justice will be carried through to the end: the goals of the SMO will be achieved, threats to Russia's security eliminated, and peaceful life restored
.

item.title: 🇷🇺 On 1 October Russian Ambassador to India Denis Alipov took part in the ceremony at the Municipal Corporation of Delhi marking the 157th birth anniversary of Mahatma Gandi.
item.description: 🇷🇺 🇮🇳 On 1 October Russian Ambassador to India Denis Alipov took part in the ceremony at the Municipal Corporation of Delhi marking the 157th birth anniversary of Mahatma Gandi. 🖼️ As part of the event the Ambassador together with the Head of the Municipal Corporation of Delhi Shri Pravesh Wahi inaugurated the “Tolstoy–Gandhi” exhibition, prepared by the Russian Embassy. The exhibition features copies of letters exchanged between the two great thinkers and reflect their philosophical ideas and intellectual dialogue. 🎙️ In his remarks the Ambassador stressed that the shared philosophical legacy of Leo Tolstoy and Mahatma Gandhi continues to serve as a bridge between Russia and India. He also noted that the exhibition demonstrates the influence of the great Russian writer’s ideas on the intellectual development of the leader of India’s national liberation movement. 🤝 Among those attending the opening were Alexander Dodonov , Head of the Russian House in Delhi, representatives of official circles and the diplomatic corps, municipal officials and journalists. 💬 The official program was followed by the active discussion. #DruzhbaDosti #RussiaIndia #MahatmaGhandi #LeoTolstoy
